name: Poke
description: Poke offers AI-driven productivity features. GAIA provides a comprehensive source-available productivity OS with 50+ integrations and proactive automation.
metaTitle: Poke vs GAIA: Source-Available AI That Acts First
metaDescription: Poke vs GAIA: Poke answers when asked but never acts first; GAIA triages email, manages tasks, and runs workflows across 50+ tools. Free tier included.
intro: Poke is a light helper for everyday tasks. It answers questions and assists, but you still direct every step. GAIA works the other way round: a source-available assistant that watches your inbox, calendar, and tasks, then acts on what it finds. It connects 50+ tools and remembers context across them, so follow-through happens without prompting.

rows.gaia: Source-available productivity OS with proactive AI that manages email, calendar, tasks, and workflows
rows.competitor: Messaging-first AI assistant acquired by Cognition in July 2026; lives inside Apple Messages, WhatsApp, Telegram, RCS, and SMS

rows.gaia: Monitors your digital life 24/7 and acts before you ask
rows.competitor: Proactive texts plus on-demand chat; actions scoped to connected integrations and messaging channels

rows.gaia: 50+ integrations including Gmail, Slack, Notion, GitHub, Todoist, Asana, Linear
rows.competitor: Gmail and Outlook plus calendar, with integrations and recipes; narrower than cross-tool orchestration

rows.gaia: Graph-based memory connecting tasks, meetings, documents, and user preferences
rows.competitor: Conversation memory that learns preferences across chats; no cross-tool graph memory

rows.gaia: Source-available (PolyForm Noncommercial) with self-hosting via Docker
Multi-step workflows with smart triggers and cross-tool orchestration
rows.competitor: Help over text with email, scheduling, reminders, and research; no multi-step cross-tool workflow engine

rows.gaia: Web app, desktop (macOS, Windows, Linux), mobile, Discord, Slack, Telegram bots
rows.competitor: No app to install; lives inside Apple Messages, Telegram, WhatsApp, RCS, and SMS

gaiaAdvantages: Source-available with full transparency and self-hosting
competitorAdvantages: Simpler onboarding for basic productivity needs
Focused feature set may be easier to learn
verdict: Choose Poke if you want a simple helper for small tasks. Choose GAIA if you want a source-available assistant that runs the whole workflow: triaging email, managing calendar and tasks, and automating across 50+ tools without being asked each time.

faqs.question: What makes GAIA different from Poke?
faqs.answer: GAIA is a complete productivity operating system that proactively manages email, calendar, tasks, and workflows across 50+ integrations. It is source-available (PolyForm Noncommercial) and self-hostable, with graph-based memory that learns your work patterns over time.
